name: ESP32-BlueJammer
summary: DIY 2.4GHz jammer built on an ESP32 and two nRF24 modules: firmware binaries, pinouts, PCB and 3D-printed case.
description: Build and flash instructions for a handheld device that disrupts Bluetooth, BLE, WiFi and RC drone traffic on the 2.4GHz band. The repo provides firmware binaries, a web flasher, HSPI/VSPI wiring pinouts, a battery mod, PCB layouts and 3D-printable cases. Firmware is closed source; the README frames it as educational and warns jamming is illegal.
contains: firmware options: Bluetooth 79CH, BLE 40CH, WiFi 14CH, RC 1-125CH and combo channels
web flasher plus manual .bin flashing instructions
HSPI/VSPI nRF24L01+ pinouts, status LED and OLED wiring, battery mod
PCB layout (7x5.5cm), parts list and V3/V4 3D-printed case files
closed-source firmware; README states educational use only, jamming is illegal
